resources.string: LUMINA

LUMINA captures call lifecycle information (when a call starts/ends and its duration) on this device only. It does not record or analyze the human content of conversations, does not synthesize \"isolation\" or \"scam\" risk from device data, and does not upload anything without your consent and a real, explicitly configured https backend. Your phone number is recorded as \u2018unknown\u2019 unless the platform genuinely provides it. This foundation does not use microphone, SMS, contacts, or social-app activity.
